catalogRegistration.role: coordinate-registration audit; photograph owns visible stars

pointSourcePresentation.positionSource: licensed ESO photographic local maxima; no Google catalogue bytes
pointSourcePresentation.qualification: native fixed-size catalogue behavior collapsed into the prepared cubemap; point positions and colors remain ESO-derived

sky.qualification: source-photographed full sky; orientation is registered to Galactic coordinates but no observer epoch or Earth ephemeris is claimed; no Sun is baked into the cubemap

analyticRadialFit.qualification: Least-squares fit to annular red-channel means from the bound native 128 by 128 Sun texture; fitted values only, no source pixels.

distanceScaling.qualification: The opaque photospheric core is projected from the IAU nominal solar radius and the object catalog's mean heliocentric distance. The retained glow profile remains a visual presentation; the distance is not epoch-specific.

provenance.source: Google Earth Pro Mars native Sun contract-derived visual standard
provenance.qualification: Mars-derived clean-room Sun appearance and camera-relative motion are shared as a cssEarth presentation standard; no per-object native Sun position or ephemeris is claimed.

controls.label: Visible color
controls.description: NASA Blue Marble, July 2004. Cloud-free land and ocean mosaic with brighter display midtones.
controls.summary: NASA Blue Marble, July 2004. Cloud-free land and ocean mosaic with brighter display midtones.
controls.title: Blue Marble Next Generation

controls.label: Cloud coverage
controls.description: Archival NASA cloud imagery over the July 2004 surface mosaic with brighter display midtones. Clouds and surface are from different observation periods; this is not live weather.
controls.summary: Archival NASA clouds over a brighter July 2004 surface mosaic. This is not live weather.
controls.title: Blue Marble cloud composite

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: GEBCO_2026 terrain model. Colors show meters above and below mean sea level; relief is shaded for readability. Ocean depths combine measured and estimated terrain. Land includes the ice surface.
controls.summary: GEBCO_2026 modeled terrain. Colors show height and depth relative to mean sea level; ocean depths include estimates.
controls.legendNote: 0 = mean sea level. Shading emphasizes relief; the color scale is unshaded. Some coastal source datums differ.
controls.title: GEBCO land and seafloor heights

controls.label: Night lights
controls.description: NASA Black Marble · 2025 annual snow-free radiance. Warm false color shows upward nighttime light on a logarithmic scale. Gray: missing data or outside 75°N–65°S coverage. This is an annual observation, not live lighting.
controls.summary: 2025 annual snow-free satellite radiance. Warm false color; logarithmic scale. Gray: missing data or outside 75°N–65°S. Aurora can remain at high latitudes. NASA Black Marble / Jurij Stare, lightpollutionmap.info.
controls.legendNote: Logarithmic color scale, capped at 100 nW/cm²/sr. Native pixels are averaged for this globe. Aurora and transient lights can remain; this does not measure sky brightness.
controls.title: Black Marble annual night lights · 2025

controls.label: ENSO
controls.description: NASA MUR · 1 km source imagery · 7 Sept 2026. Sea-surface temperature departure from the 2003–2014 average. NASA colors saturate below −3 and at +3 °C. Gray: land, ice, or unavailable imagery.
controls.legendNote: NASA imagery uses 0.1 °C color bins; the NOAA advisory describes the coupled ocean–atmosphere state.
controls.title: ENSO: sea-surface temperature anomalies · 7 Sept 2026

controls.label: Cross section
controls.description: Schematic interior based on NASA Science. Layer boundaries and colors illustrate the model; this is not direct interior imaging.
controls.summary: A cut through Earth’s crust, rocky mantle, liquid outer core and solid inner core. Layer sizes follow the NASA Science model; colors are schematic.
controls.title: Interior structure model

controls.label: Mantle tomography
controls.description: GLAD-M35 (2024) seismic model. Mantle colors show slower and faster vertically polarized shear waves relative to the global mean at the same depth. Crust and core are schematic.
controls.summary: Red and blue map slower and faster mantle waves relative to the mean at each depth. This is not temperature. Crust and core colors are schematic; gray marks depths outside the model.
controls.legendNote: GLAD-M35 r0.1 · 10–2,890 km depth · 1° / 10 km sample grid. Gray: outside model depth coverage. Grid spacing is not resolving power.
controls.title: GLAD-M35 mantle tomography
